Q3_verdict.branch: v^2 < 0 (v2/c2 = -1.921e-9): numerator -4.207e-29 /m < 0, denominator +2.190e-20 /m; not the >= 1 side
Q3_verdict.cause: the lapse gradient itself is negative (dlnN_dR = -1.967e-29 /m at phi = pi/4, lapse decreasing outward); the HI pressure term (pgrad = -2.240e-29 /m) has the same sign and supplies 53% of the negative numerator. Without pressure v^2 would still be < 0, so it is lapse-driven, not asymmetric-drift-dominated. Azimuthal-mean pressure/lapse ratio at R=1.48 is 0.24 (a0 pgrad -0.47e-28 vs a0 dlnN 1.98e-28).
